decisions.reason: As a core-adjacent 2023 launch with its own webpage, Product A reflects visible public commitment and invested development effort, so management would likely continue it while expecting market acceptance to build.

Because Product B is close to the firm's established skincare offer and there is no clear evidence of failure, management would tend to retain it and justify the recent investment as part of ongoing innovation.
Product C fits the firm's existing natural facial-care range and, absent strong negative signals, management would likely keep it on the market rather than reverse a recent launch commitment.
